question: The 15th G20 Summit held virtually in November 2020 was hosted by _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 15th G20 Summit held virtually in November 2020 was hosted by **Saudi Arabia**.
 
• It saw the participation of respective Heads of State/ Government of 19 member countries, the EU, other invited countries, and international organizations.
 
• The theme for the 15th summit was Realizing Opportunities of the 21st Cent
